message.content:
Yes—**early Coca-Cola did contain cocaine** in the late 1800s, because its original formula used coca leaf extract that included cocaine.[1][6] Coca-Cola says **today it does not contain cocaine**, and that cocaine has **never been an added ingredient** in the modern product.[2]

The historical details are that Coca-Cola was invented in 1885, and the original recipe included coca leaf extract; sources differ slightly on the timeline for removal, but they agree the cocaine was taken out in the early 1900s and later replaced with *de-cocainized* coca leaf extract.[1][4][6] Today, the company says the drink contains no cocaine, only flavoring derived from coca leaves that have had the cocaine removed.[2][6]
